FP-003.text: Hermes Agent (Nous Research), two tool surfaces: (1) terminal — add deny globs in ~/.hermes/config.yaml, approvals: { deny: ['*<command_bin>*<protected_path>*'] }; deny matching extracts executable candidates from compounds and wrappers, so subpath forms under <protected_path> match the glob without enumerating each file (fnmatch * spans the subtree as text).
